grammarFocus: much / many / a little / a few；数量表达；should / should not。
title: A Shopping Trip for a Family Dinner
instructions: 阅读下面的短文，然后回答问题。所有题目均为单选题或填空题。填空题答案必须与原文完全一致，且不超过字数限制。本材料为模拟教学材料，不是官方雅思考试。
passage:
Li Wei is a university student in Shanghai. He lives with his parents and his sister. On Saturday, his family will have a big dinner. His mother wants to cook a special meal. She asks Li Wei to go shopping with her.

At the supermarket, Li Wei's mother says, "We need some vegetables. We have a little rice at home, but we don't have many vegetables. We need a few tomatoes and some carrots. We also need some chicken. We don't need much meat because your father wants to eat more vegetables."

Li Wei sees a lot of snacks. He likes chips and chocolate. He asks, "Can we buy some chips?" His mother says, "You should not eat many chips. They are not healthy. You should eat more fruit. We can buy a few apples and some bananas."

Li Wei puts the chips back. He says, "OK, Mom. You are right. I should eat less junk food." They buy a little cheese and a few eggs, too. Then they go home.

At home, Li Wei's mother cooks dinner. She uses a little salt and a few spices. She does not use much oil. The dinner is delicious. Li Wei says, "I should help you cook more often. And I should not eat so many snacks." His mother smiles and says, "Good. You should also drink more water. It is good for your health."

questions.prompt: What does Li Wei's mother say about vegetables at home?
options: They have many vegetables at home.
They don't have many vegetables at home.
They have a few vegetables at home.
They have no vegetables at home.
answers: They don't have many vegetables at home.
questions.explanation: 原文说“We don't have many vegetables.”，意思是家里蔬菜不多。

questions.prompt: Why does Li Wei's mother say they don't need much meat?
options: Because Li Wei doesn't like meat.
Because they have a lot of meat at home.
Because Li Wei's father wants to eat more vegetables.
answers: Because Li Wei's father wants to eat more vegetables.
questions.explanation: 原文说“We don't need much meat because your father wants to eat more vegetables.”，原因是父亲想多吃蔬菜。
questions.evidence: We don't need much meat because your father wants to eat more vegetables.

questions.prompt: What does Li Wei's mother say about chips?
options: You should not eat many chips.
You should eat a few chips.
You should not eat any chips.
answers: You should not eat many chips.
questions.explanation: 母亲说“You should not eat many chips.”，建议不要吃很多薯片。
questions.evidence: You should not eat many chips.

questions.prompt: What fruit does Li Wei's mother suggest buying?
options: A few apples and some bananas
A few oranges and some grapes
Many apples and a few bananas
Some apples and a little fruit
answers: A few apples and some bananas
questions.explanation: 母亲说“We can buy a few apples and some bananas.”，建议买几个苹果和一些香蕉。
questions.evidence: We can buy a few apples and some bananas.

questions.prompt: Fill in the blank with one word from the passage: Li Wei's mother uses a little ______ and a few spices when she cooks dinner.
questions.explanation: 原文说“She uses a little salt and a few spices.”，所以填salt。
questions.evidence: She uses a little salt and a few spices.

questions.prompt: Fill in the blank with one word from the passage: Li Wei says he should not eat so many ______.
questions.explanation: 原文说“I should not eat so many snacks.”，所以填snacks。
questions.evidence: I should not eat so many snacks.

questions.prompt: What does Li Wei's mother say he should drink more of?
questions.explanation: 母亲说“You should also drink more water.”，建议多喝水。
questions.evidence: You should also drink more water.

questions.prompt: True, False, or Not Given: Li Wei's mother buys a lot of cheese.
questions.explanation: 原文说“They buy a little cheese”，是“a little”而不是“a lot of”，所以与原文矛盾，答案为False。
questions.evidence: They buy a little cheese and a few eggs, too.

questions.prompt: True, False, or Not Given: Li Wei's mother uses a lot of oil when she cooks.
questions.explanation: 原文说“She does not use much oil.”，即用油不多，与“a lot of oil”矛盾，所以答案为False。
questions.evidence: She does not use much oil.

questions.prompt: True, False, or Not Given: Li Wei's mother drinks tea every day.
questions.explanation: 原文没有提到母亲每天喝茶，只提到她建议多喝水，所以答案为Not Given。

grammar.title: 数量表达：much / many / a little / a few；should / should not
grammar.explanation: much 用于不可数名词（如 meat, oil, water），many 用于可数名词复数（如 vegetables, chips, snacks）。a little 表示“一点”，用于不可数名词；a few 表示“几个”，用于可数名词复数。should 表示“应该”，should not 表示“不应该”，后接动词原形。
grammar.example: We don't have many vegetables. She uses a little salt and a few spices. You should not eat many chips.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct word: We don't have ______ rice at home.
questions.explanation: rice 是不可数名词，否定句中用 much。
questions.evidence: We have a little rice at home.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct word: There are ______ apples on the table.
questions.explanation: apples 是可数名词复数，表示“几个”用 a few。
questions.evidence: We can buy a few apples.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct word: You ______ eat more fruit. It is good for you.
questions.explanation: 表示建议“应该”吃更多水果，用 should。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct word: He ______ eat too many sweets.
questions.explanation: 表示“不应该”吃太多糖果，用 should not。
questions.evidence: You should not eat many chips.
